name: Rice (Sali / Kharif Paddy)
soil_effect: Heavy nutrient depletion (N-P-K); continuous flooding can cause subsoil compaction.

notes.verified_facts: Staple monsoon crop of Assam; shallow fibrous root system; heavy feeder requiring rotation.
notes.rough_estimates: 1100 mm water requirement varies (900-1400 mm) depending on rainfall retention.

name: Mustard (Toria / Rapeseed)
soil_effect: Deep taproot breaks hard soil layers and accesses deep nutrients; pest-break crop after rice.

notes.verified_facts: Major winter cash crop of Assam; thrives on residual post-monsoon soil moisture; deep taproot.
notes.rough_estimates: 300 mm water requirement assumes 1-2 supplemental irrigations or good residual moisture.

name: Lentil (Masoor Dal)
soil_effect: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen (~30-40 kg N/ha) via root nodules, restoring depleted soil after heavy feeders.

notes.verified_facts: Leguminous biological nitrogen fixer; highly drought-resilient cool season crop.
notes.rough_estimates: 30-40 kg N/ha fixed is an agronomic estimate; depends on local Rhizobium strains.

name: Potato (Aloo)
soil_effect: High potassium and nitrogen consumer; soil loosening from earthing up and harvesting improves tilth.

notes.verified_facts: High-value winter tuber; sensitive to dry spells and waterlogging; shallow root feeder.
notes.rough_estimates: 500 mm water need and profit return assume responsive market and cold-storage access.

name: Jute (Pat / Fiber Crop)
soil_effect: Massive leaf shedding adds 2-3 tons/ha of rich organic mulch; strong taproot aerates dense subsoil.

notes.verified_facts: Traditional pre-monsoon fiber of Assam floodplains; high biomass producer and organic matter builder.
notes.rough_estimates: 2-3 tons/ha organic leaf-fall estimate based on standard ICAR-CRIJAF fiber trials.
